preconditions.description: The number of chairs n must be between 2 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= e <= n and s != e
preconditions.description: The starting position s and ending position e must be valid chair numbers and different.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(x[i] < x[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: The coordinates x must be distinct and in increasing order.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All landing times a must be positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All landing times b must be positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All jumping off times c must be positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= d[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All jumping off times d must be positive integers.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum time Scott needs to get to Cross while visiting each chair exactly once.
